methods.name: cards.info
methods.description: Read scheduling metadata and review history for a card.

methods.name: cards.preview
methods.description: Render a card outside the study queue without scheduling it.

methods.name: cards.bury
methods.description: Bury selected cards or all sibling cards until the next day.

methods.name: cards.unbury
methods.description: Restore selected buried cards or their siblings.

methods.name: cards.suspend
methods.description: Suspend selected cards or all cards of the selected notes.

methods.name: cards.unsuspend
methods.description: Restore suspended selected cards or their siblings.

methods.name: cards.flag
methods.description: Set or clear one of Anki's seven card flags.

methods.name: cards.forget
methods.description: Reset cards to new, optionally resetting review and lapse counters.

methods.name: cards.setDueDate
methods.description: Set due dates with Anki's day-range syntax and optional interval reset.

methods.name: cards.reposition
methods.description: Reposition new cards with start, step, shuffle and shift controls.

methods.name: cards.setDeck
methods.description: Move cards to a normal deck, restoring filtered-deck state.

methods.name: cards.remove
methods.description: Delete cards and notes which no longer have any cards.

methods.name: cards.setUserFlagNames
methods.description: Persist user-visible labels for seven flags.

methods.name: cards.userFlagNames
methods.description: Read the seven user-visible flag labels.
